name: MedBench
intro: MedBench是面向中文医疗大模型的综合、标准化评测体系，整合8个公开数据集并自建12个数据集，共包含300,901道题目，覆盖43个临床专业和医学语言理解、生成、知识问答、复杂推理、安全伦理五个维度。其云端平台物理隔离题目与标准答案，并通过选项循环打乱和随机提示匹配减少捷径学习。
org: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Ruijin Hospital
build_method: 公开数据整合, 专家构建, 医生核验, 动态评测
eval_feature: 五维综合评测, 43个临床专业, 选项循环打乱, 随机提示匹配
build_method_en: Public-data integration, expert construction, physician verification, dynamic evaluation
eval_feature_en: Five-dimensional evaluation, 43 clinical specialties, circular choice shuffling, random prompt matching
intro_en: MedBench is a comprehensive, standardized evaluation system for Chinese medical LLMs. It combines eight public datasets with twelve newly constructed datasets, totaling 300,901 questions across 43 clinical specialties and five dimensions: medical language understanding, generation, knowledge QA, complex reasoning, and safety and ethics. Its cloud platform physically separates questions from gold answers and uses circular choice shuffling plus random prompt matching to reduce shortcut learning.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2407.10990 and the official MedBench platform. The diagrams preserve the five MLU, MLG, MKQA, CMR, and HSE dimensions; eight public plus twelve self-constructed datasets; five-stage curation; the SCARE 2023 rewrite and three-senior-doctor approval route for DDx-basic, DDx-advanced, and MedTreat; two-physician verification; 300,901 Chinese questions across 20 datasets and 43 specialties; the balanced 8,913-record cloud evaluation sample and quarterly refresh; physical question/gold separation; exhaustive circular choice shuffling; random selection from three prompts; Accuracy, BLEU, ROUGE-L, and Micro-F1 scoring; five-dimension aggregation; and blinded validation by three senior physicians.
